grammar.summary: 本课继续间接引语练习，引入 tell 的引述用法。

points.title: tell sb. that... 引述结构
points.explanation: 引述动词 tell + 人 + 从句：She told me (that) she... 说"告诉某人"必须带间接宾语，不能说 told that。

examples.en: She told me that she would get married next month.
examples.cn: 她告诉我她下个月要结婚。

points.title: 间接引语的时态回移（初步）
points.explanation: 引述动词过去时（told），从句现在时→过去时、将来时→过去将来时：will→would。

examples.en: He said he would see her later.
